description.value: Delicious Pizza & Pasta is a Victoria restaurant recognized by Black Press as one of the top three best pizzas in the city every year from 2018 to 2023. The menu covers specialty, gourmet, Indian-inspired, and build-your-own pizzas alongside pastas, salads, and sides, with strong dietary accommodation across the board. Cyclists on Douglas Street will find a full sit-down or takeout meal with broad dietary options available.
